Job opportunity
Flight Safety Engineer – Graduate (synthetic test posting)
Northtown (SE)•Sweden•Permanent
Description
Start Date: 2027-09-01

Submission Deadline: 2027-05-31
Requirements
* Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

* Interest in trajectory prediction, dispersion and safety analysis for rocket launches.
* Fluency in English; Swedish is required for communication with local authorities.
Responsibilities
* Run trajectory and impact-dispersion simulations before each launch.
* Document risk analyses for sounding rockets and balloons.

Example Space Corp has more than 50 years of experience and offers rocket and balloon systems, launch services and satellite operations to customers worldwide.
